acceptance_scope: Engineering design may proceed to minimal implementation. This does not approve a runner, PB/G0/model/PG/CI execution, old software migration or full product qualification.
required_boundaries: Mint only from real original completed closed dual source Release with current full source permissions, actual three receipts/two complete sinks and no material/logic-derived source remint.
Two-sum consent must match audited execution_version both at fresh mint and on load of paired original authorize request; mixed legacy consent is rejected, including jointly resealed requests.

Source schema validated dynamically against original private aggregate_steps, while public recipe/schema use only canonical read,total_a,total_b; no source step names, original column names/content/hash/id into public registry.
Existing VERSION/LogicOrigin family may remain only with exact audited execution_version + canonical recipe/schema dispatch; old scalar request/response canonical values preserved.
target_for_schema continues to receive the original strict ordinary single-result SCHEMA; dual output canonical schema is not used to weaken that target gate.
Strict new dual columns model exactly canonical two keys; canonical source-free construction for base_origin, prepare_instance_plan and derived plan_origin validates every per-step input and column.
Global frozen limits retained, original three-node conservative /3 compiler and max_repairs=0; no new grants, identity, tools or capability permissions.

Post-mint audit may hash/check immutable old Release/approval snapshot and scalar Run identity, but no old resource SELECT or old Run.result/context/operations content; do not describe immutable JSON audit as zero old-JSON access.

Same-key authorize recovery may return existing exact authority after old resource becomes unavailable, without minting a new one or refreshing TTL; new-key mint still requires current full source permissions.
Queued/each step/final typed transaction retain active independent authority, TTL, current target permissions, budget and atomic rollback; no marker/origin drop or plain-plan downgrade.

UI dedicated consent and fixed labels/two columns, exact dual recipe/schema/plan receipt, old-source-free cold registry HTTP restore, unknown/late/identity generation fencing and separate plan/run/release/instance confirmations.
necessary_author_tests: Mint before new target creation; revoke/delete only old synthetic resource; old original Release and fresh-key re-mint reject, existing same-key recovery returns unchanged TTL/authority.
SQL raw-parameter and selected-column observation after mint covers registry/options/plan/Worker/release/instance/cold/revoke paths; explicitly allow immutable old Release/approval audit only.
Actual no-model target DAG and independent Fraction oracle for both full outputs, cold Store swapped columns, original immutable history and principals/grants retained after test setup mutations.
Wrong/single/mixed/extra-key dual mapping, same-column two sinks, source app/resource alias, wrong owner/project/hash/version, paired request consent and origin/derived marker tampering reject.
Independent authority revoked/expired queued, after first sum and at final typed commit: no next operation or partial typed append, original rollback and effect semantics preserved.
Old scalar logic and recently added dual-material regression plus real HTTP/JSDOM dedicated dual consent, unknown/late receipts and cold normalized two-column restore.
